2607.27154.title: Anatomy Contextualized Adaption of CT Foundation Models
2607.27154.paper_summary: CT vision-language foundation models have demonstrated promising performance across downstream tasks, but are typically trained with whole-volume representations that dilute fine-grained anatomical signals. Fine-grained vision-language pre-training addresses this by aligning anatomy-level visual features with anatomy-specific text, but in doing so discards the global context that whole-volume models provide. Furthermore, existing fine-grained approaches train from scratch, making them computationally expensive. We introduce Anatomy Contextualized Adaptation (ACA), a lightweight framework that adapts frozen CT foundation model representations for anatomy-level vision-language alignment while enhancing global contextualization. ACA uses TotalSegmentator to decompose CT volumes into anatomy-level embeddings, which are refined via a transformer that captures cross-anatomy relationships, and aligned to both per-anatomy and scan-level text extracted from radiology reports. Evaluated on Merlin and CT-RATE, ACA consistently outperforms both the frozen foundation model baselines and existing fine-grained methods in zero-shot finding classification, while requiring less than one hour of training once embeddings are cached. The attention weights learned by ACA's inter-anatomy transformer additionally indicate plausible cross-anatomy context routing. Altogether, these results support ACA as a lightweight approach for adapting CT foundation models to anatomically grounded vision-language alignment while preserving and enhancing global anatomical context.
2607.27154.paper_summary_zh: CT 影像-語言基礎模型在下游任務中表現出色，但通常是使用整體體積表示進行訓練，這會稀釋細粒度的解剖信號。細粒度的影像-語言預訓練通過將解剖層級的視覺特徵與特定解剖的文本對齊來解決這一問題，但這樣做卻丟失了整體體積模型所提供的全局上下文。此外，現有的細粒度方法通常是從頭開始訓練，這使得它們在計算上非常昂貴。我們提出了解剖上下文適應（Anatomy Contextualized Adaptation，ACA），這是一個輕量級框架，旨在適應凍結的 CT 基礎模型表示，以實現解剖層級的影像-語言對齊，同時增強全局上下文。ACA 使用 TotalSegmentator 將 CT 體積分解為解剖層級的嵌入，這些嵌入通過捕捉跨解剖關係的Transformer進行精煉，並與從放射學報告中提取的每個解剖和掃描層級的文本對齊。在 Merlin 和 CT-RATE 上進行評估時，ACA 在零樣本查找分類中始終超越凍結基礎模型基準和現有的細粒度方法，同時在嵌入緩存後的訓練時間少於一小時。ACA 的跨解剖Transformer學習的注意權重還表明了合理的跨解剖上下文路由。總體而言，這些結果支持 ACA 作為一種輕量級的方法，用於將 CT 基礎模型適應於解剖學上扎根的影像-語言對齊，同時保持和增強全局解剖上下文。
